records.detail: Residents of Mudichur, who have been hit hardest due to flooding, had held a meeting, demanding action to prevent inundation in the future.
Residents had to suffer the agony of sewage mixed rainwater entering their homes, due to a fault in the drainage system.
Mudichur Road has been hit badly by the torrential rains, causing traffic to be diverted.
An overflow from the Selaiyur Lake, inundates the locality.
Encroachments on waterbodies and blocking of runoff path have been listed as the major causes for the flood-like situation.
